purpose: Admit a species-disjoint Lepidoptera empirical panel using only canonical-valid versus noncanonical aligned-character masks before any new nucleotide identity, pairwise genetic distance, or empirical transfer statistic is computed.

mask_contract.valid_frozen_edge: At least one sequence pair across the two frozen endpoint localities has canonical-valid overlap >= ceil(0.5 * alignment_length).
mask_contract.failed_species: Drop the species only; do not rewire its graph, switch marker, or substitute a different locus.

forbidden: Persist nucleotide identities or pairwise nucleotide differences during the mask stage.
Change trait axes, trait-similarity rule, geometry covariates, alignment cap, support rule, simulator amplitudes, alpha, or qualification gates after mask opening.
Resplit or rebalance train/evaluation species after mask opening.
Open the new Lepidoptera empirical genetic response before the exact survivor-geometry requalification passes.
